↻ Harness evals: when AGENTS.md, skills, hooks, agents or check scripts change
1. Owner runs scripts/eval-run.sh: the smoke set (~5 tasks), or all tasks for a baseline
2. Real tasks from the repo (remove, replay, bugfix) go through stages 1 to 6 in a throwaway copy
3. Scored on 6 checks: committed, unit, spec, mutation, format, hidden answer-key tests
4. Compared with the last run at the same agent, model and effort: keep or revert the change
